item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00209","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C21","C10","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C21","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C21 is the exact earlier Ecuador proclamation that the child expressly identifies and amends. The child reproduces C21’s statutory and treaty background, notice-based six-month termination mechanism, and original operative termination date, then revises the two dates after withdrawal and replacement of the notice. This is direct reuse of both language and administrative structure, not merely similarity of subject matter.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of August 27, 1955 ... the President proclaimed that the said proclamation dated September 23, 1938 should be terminated as of the close of January 17, 1956","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim that the said proclamation dated September 23, 1938, shall be terminated as of the close of January 17, 1956","explanation":"The child expressly incorporates and describes C21’s operative act and original effective date."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas Article XIX of the said trade agreement provides that the agreement shall remain in force and effect until six months from the day on which either Government shall give notice of its intention to terminate it","parent_excerpt":"Whereas Article XIX of the said trade agreement provides that the agreement shall remain in force and effect until six months from the day on which either Government shall give notice of its intention to terminate it","explanation":"This distinctive recital is reproduced verbatim and supplies the mechanism governing the revised termination date."},{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim that the said proclamation of August 27, 1955 shall be amended (1) by deleting \"July 18, 1955\" ... and inserting \"January 17, 1956\" ... and (2) by deleting \"January 17, 1956\" ... and inserting \"July 16, 1956\"","parent_excerpt":"six months from the day on which notice of termination of the said trade agreement was given by the Government of the United States of America","explanation":"The child directly edits the notice and termination dates embedded in C21 while preserving its six-month calculation structure."}]}
